principle: Portable collaboration state should be provider-independent; provider-specific APIs and identities are projections.

sources.pattern: Issues in Git storage; modular bridge import/export; one identity layer per provider.
sources.limits: Provider bridge capabilities differ and should be checked before claiming two-way fidelity.

sources.pattern: Event-sourced refs/issues/* with immutable IDs and Provider-ID mapping; import/export across four forge families.
sources.limits: Cross-forge comment update/delete and multiple simultaneous writers need independent collision testing.

sources.pattern: Three-way local/original/remote comparison; skip on concurrent conflict.
sources.limits: Local GitHub workflow, not turnkey cross-forge synchronization.

sources.pattern: Interoperable forge and identity protocol: prefer identity/federation over synchronized shadow copies long-term.
sources.limits: Forgejo federation experimental as of mid 2026, with explicitly warned domain compatibility risks.

sources.pattern: GitLab as authoritative forge with GitHub outward-facing mirror; incoming issues, wiki, PRs and releases.
sources.limits: Historical feature request; not evidence the complete feature exists.

sources.pattern: Document conflicts from simultaneous edits, force-push and rewritten history before permitting bidirectional Git.
